## About
B & M Transmission Service is a local, family owned and operated shop on the South Side of Indianapolis. We started out as a general repair shop and later began doing transmissions. Transmissions have been our focus ever since.
We are transmission specialists, and we handle the paperwork for you, too. Call or email us and we'll get back to you.
You'll find us at 2702 South Meridian Street, open weekdays. Customers on Google rate us 4.4 from 80 reviews.

## Services
- Transmission rebuilding and repair: When your transmission is slipping or acting up, bring it in. We rebuild and repair transmissions right here in the shop.
- Transmission maintenance: Regular transmission maintenance to help keep your vehicle running the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: Are warranties available?
A: We have 3 year unlimited mileage warranties available. Ask us about the details for your vehicle.

Q: How fast can I get an estimate?
A: You can count on us for an estimate within an hour.

Q: How quickly will you get back to me?
A: We return calls and emails the same day.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
